title: Two new stretch roles + your top open favorites
intro: A quiet Saturday on the French-tied boards: two newly posted roles worth a look, both stretches on years of experience — a Biolage advocacy & influencer partnerships manager at L'Oréal in New York, and a Hennessy field marketing manager in the Bay Area. Heads up: NYX Global Brand Partnerships (#20) has closed. Your YTTP favorite (#3) and Redken (#31) are still open.

sections.title: New today
sections.intro: Verified live Oct 17. Both are stretches on years required.

sections.title: Still open (favorites)
sections.intro: Spot-checked live this morning on careers.loreal.com.

notes: #20 Assistant Manager, Global Brand Partnerships (NYX) now returns a closed-job page on careers.loreal.com.
SMCP Group: Greenhouse still NY corporate (AR Coordinator, Allocation Planner Maje) + retail only — no US marketing/brand/partnerships.
Christian Dior Couture has a Trainee, PR – Entertainment Relations role in LA, but it's a $20/hour postgraduate trainee program, so it isn't numbered.
L'Oréal Manager, Affiliate Activation (CPD TikTok Shop, NY) is live but asks for 5–7 years — too senior to number.
Pernod Ricard Manager, Senior Field Marketing (Los Angeles) still live but 7+ years.
L'Occitane, Polène, Diptyque, and Pernod US boards: no new confirmed US marketing openings.

jobs.title: Manager, Advocacy and Influence — Biolage
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 from home), per the posting
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); Biolage is in the Professional Products Division.
jobs.travel: Domestic travel periodically (25%) — posting does not mention Paris
jobs.why: A partnerships-heavy seat: creator casting and contract negotiation, agency and partner relationships, retailer-specific programs, and creator events for Biolage. Relationship building and negotiating map well to your AE background.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 4–6 years in marketing, branding, or product management.

jobs.title: Manager, Field Marketing — Hennessy (Northern California)
jobs.location: San Francisco / East Bay, CA (must live in the SF–Oakland–East Bay market)
jobs.french_tie: Hennessy is a Cognac house in France; Moët Hennessy is part of LVMH (Paris HQ).
jobs.why: Localizing Hennessy's brand programming and community engagement in Northern California — hands-on brand marketing with lots of partner and account relationships.
jobs.stretch_note: Requires a minimum of 5 years, and it's Bay Area rather than LA.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Global Marketing (Youth to the People)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); Youth To The People global marketing.
jobs.why: Still open — the YTTP global marketing role you already asked for a tailored resume for.

jobs.title: Assistant Marketing Manager, Redken US (Hair Color)
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 from home)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); Redken is in the Professional Products Division.
jobs.travel: Domestic travel periodically, up to 25% — posting does not mention Paris
jobs.why: Still open — the most realistic-level new role from this week (1–3 years required).
jobs.title_note: Careers site short title is "Asst Mgr - Marketing- Hair Color"; role body is Assistant Marketing Manager, Redken US (Hair Color).
